name: seed-followup-tests
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp --remove-destination seed-test-inputs/dsl.ts core/dsl.ts; cp --remove-destination seed-test-inputs/proof-output.ts core/proof-output.ts; cp --remove-destination seed-test-inputs/candidate-seeds.ts core/candidate-seeds.ts; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.candidate-seed.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/candidate-seed.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed-public.test.ts research/bapa/counted-seed.test.ts research/bapa/sum-seed.test.ts research/bapa/kind-seed.test.ts research/bapa/field-seed.test.ts research/bapa/native-tuple-seed.test.ts research/bapa/multi-family-seed.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; for message in seed-test-inputs/sum-message.txt seed-test-inputs/tuple-message.txt; do bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$message"; done > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; sha256sum core/dsl.ts core/proof-output.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/source-boundary.sha256"
